page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.g7t.2xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute tasks. It demonstrates stable mid-range capabilities in single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, as well as standard software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing workloads. However, memory subsystem performance presents a notable tradeoff. While cached small-block memory reads are average, large-block uncached memory read and write bandwidths fall into the bottom 25% tier, which is mirrored by a weak PassMark memory score and lower throughput in Redis SET operations.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, database operations, and lightweight text or image processing. It is also capable of handling small-scale language model inference, though performance degrades significantly to the bottom 10% when processing medium-sized 7B models. The lack of local storage and dedicated GPUs makes it less suitable for high-performance storage-heavy databases or intensive deep learning tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this server offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, utilizing a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. Performance benchmarks indicate average capabilities for standard compute tasks, including software compilation, web serving, and database operations. However, uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidths are relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25%. This resource profile makes the instance highly suitable for general-purpose application hosting, static web serving, and moderate database workloads, while presenting a clear performance tradeoff for memory-intensive operations and larger machine learning models.
